title: When to Invoke: Refining LLM Fairness with Toxicity Assessment

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual substitution of demographic entity terms (spanning race, religion, and immigration status) in implicit hate speech sentence templates, followed by measuring the variance and stability of the model's toxicity probability predictions across the different entities using metrics like Sentence Fairness Variance (SFV) and Entity Fairness Dispersion (EFD).
